energy_matrix.name: Energy Matrix
energy_matrix.description: A compact lattice that regulates and distributes energy, serving as a stable power foundation for various ship systems.

kinetic_amplifier.name: Kinetic Amplifier
kinetic_amplifier.description: A device that magnifies impulse-based energy transfer, boosting the effectiveness of systems relying on kinetic force.

radiation_shielding.name: Radiation Shielding
radiation_shielding.description: A dense composite material designed to absorb and dissipate harmful cosmic radiation, safeguarding sensitive ship systems.

pulse_emitter.name: Pulse Emitter
pulse_emitter.description: A sophisticated device that generates and modulates high-frequency energy pulses, essential for rapid-cycling systems.

overcharge_coil.name: Overcharge Coil
overcharge_coil.description: A high-yield coil that enables a massive surge in power throughput, pushing systems beyond their standard operational limits.

stellar_core.name: Stellar Core
stellar_core.description: A power source containing the condensed energy of a stellar body, providing immense and sustained power for elite-grade systems.

quantum_capacitor.name: Quantum Capacitor
quantum_capacitor.description: A highly advanced capacitor that leverages quantum mechanics to store and release energy with near-perfect efficiency.

shield_capacitor.name: Shield Capacitor
shield_capacitor.description: A compact unit for the temporary storage and rapid discharge of energy, vital for systems that require on-demand power surges.

energy_barrier.name: Energy Barrier
energy_barrier.description: A component that projects a resilient energy field, capable of deflecting or absorbing high levels of incoming energy.

graviton_emitter.name: Graviton Emitter
graviton_emitter.description: A specialized device that generates localized gravitational fields, capable of manipulating kinetic forces and altering trajectories.

plasma_deflector.name: Plasma Deflector
plasma_deflector.description: A magnetic containment unit that can shape and redirect superheated plasma, providing advanced thermal and energy defense.

bio_shield_core.name: Bio-Shield Core
bio_shield_core.description: A living core composed of self-repairing organic matter that can generate and sustain protective bio-energy fields.

armor_plating.name: Armor Plating
armor_plating.description: A high-density alloy plate used to reinforce structural integrity and improve resilience against physical impacts.

reinforced_alloy.name: Reinforced Alloy
reinforced_alloy.description: A specially treated metallic composite that offers superior durability and stress resistance for high-performance modules.

kinetic_dampener.name: Kinetic Dampener
kinetic_dampener.description: A device that neutralizes kinetic energy from impacts, reducing stress and damage to integrated systems.

nano_repair_matrix.name: Nano-Repair Matrix
nano_repair_matrix.description: A matrix of microscopic nanites that can actively repair structural damage by reconfiguring matter at a molecular level.

quantum_armor_core.name: Quantum Armor Core
quantum_armor_core.description: A core material forged with a quantum-entangled structure, making it exceptionally resistant to physical and energetic disruption.

thruster_core.name: Thruster Core
thruster_core.description: A fundamental propulsion component that efficiently converts power into directional thrust for maneuvering.

propulsion_booster.name: Propulsion Booster
propulsion_booster.description: An auxiliary unit designed to augment the output of propulsion systems, providing a significant boost in acceleration.

warp_coil.name: Warp Coil
warp_coil.description: A crucial component for FTL travel, these coils generate the intense energy fields required to bend spacetime.

plasma_thruster.name: Plasma Thruster
plasma_thruster.description: A high-performance thruster that ejects superheated plasma to achieve superior acceleration and top speeds.

quantum_drive_core.name: Quantum Drive Core
quantum_drive_core.description: The heart of an elite propulsion system, utilizing quantum principles to convert energy into thrust with unparalleled efficiency.

sensor_array.name: Sensor Array
sensor_array.description: An advanced suite of sensors that gathers and processes vast amounts of spatial data, enhancing a ship's tactical awareness.

stabilizer_node.name: Stabilizer Node
stabilizer_node.description: A regulatory node that smooths out power fluctuations, ensuring connected systems operate at peak and stable performance.

plasma_amplifier.name: Plasma Amplifier
plasma_amplifier.description: A device that excites and amplifies plasma streams, drastically increasing their thermal energy and destructive potential.

void_core.name: Void Core
void_core.description: A rare core harnessing raw energy from the void, used to power the most advanced and exotic ship technologies.

weapon_memory_bank.name: Weapon Memory Bank
weapon_memory_bank.description: A module containing combat data and configurations extracted from dismantled spaceship weapon systems, used to enhance or replicate offensive capabilities.

shield_memory_bank.name: Shield Memory Bank
shield_memory_bank.description: A module storing energy patterns and defensive protocols derived from disassembled spaceship shields, enabling reconstruction or upgrades of protective barriers.

armor_memory_bank.name: Armor Memory Bank
armor_memory_bank.description: A module holding material data and structural integrity metrics from deconstructed spaceship armor, aiding in the recreation or improvement of defensive plating.

engine_memory_bank.name: Engine Memory Bank
engine_memory_bank.description: A module with performance data and propulsion configurations salvaged from disassembled spaceship engines, supporting the rebuild or optimization of power systems.
